solid_carcinoma_nests: Cohesive nests and solid sheets of large epithelial tumor cells with enlarged, pleomorphic, hyperchromatic nuclei, prominent nucleoli, mitoses and more abundant cytoplasm, sharply replacing or pushing aside the surrounding small lymphocytes.
glandular_carcinoma: Metastatic ductal carcinoma forming irregular glands or tubules with central lumina, lined by crowded atypical epithelial cells with enlarged nuclei and visible nucleoli, set within lymphoid tissue or fibrous stroma.
discohesive_lobular_carcinoma: Loosely scattered single tumor cells or single-file cords of uniform, medium-sized cells with round eccentric nuclei and pale or mucin-filled cytoplasm, sometimes signet-ring shaped, infiltrating the lymph node, often within sinuses.
isolated_tumor_cells: Single large epithelial cells or tiny clusters of a few cells, with enlarged irregular nuclei and pale cytoplasm, scattered among dense sheets of small dark lymphocytes or within a sinus; the tumor occupies only a small part of the field.
desmoplastic_tumor_stroma: Reactive fibrous stroma inside a metastasis: pale pink, loose or hyalinized collagen with plump activated fibroblasts, surrounding and separating nests or glands of atypical epithelial tumor cells.
lymphocytes: Dense sheets of small, round, uniformly dark lymphocyte nuclei with scant cytoplasm, closely packed and evenly distributed, forming the diffuse lymphoid tissue and follicles of a lymph node on H&E staining.
germinal_center: A pale zone of a lymphoid follicle containing larger centroblasts and centrocytes with vesicular nuclei and visible nucleoli, scattered mitoses, and tingible-body macrophages with pale cytoplasm and phagocytosed debris, giving a starry-sky appearance.
sinus_histiocytes: Lymph node sinus filled with clusters of large histiocytes with abundant pale pink or foamy cytoplasm and bland, oval, eccentric nuclei, lying loosely within open sinus spaces between lymphoid tissue.
adipose_tissue: Perinodal fat composed of large, empty, polygonal clear spaces separated by thin pink cell membranes, with flattened peripheral nuclei and few other cells.
fibrous_stroma_vessels: Lymph node capsule and trabeculae of dense pink collagen fibers with sparse elongated spindle nuclei, containing blood vessels lined by flat endothelial cells and filled with red blood cells.
artifact_background: Non-diagnostic area: blank white or pale background at the tissue edge, or tissue distorted by artifacts such as darker folded double-thickness tissue, crushed or cauterized smeared dark nuclei, out-of-focus blur, air bubbles, ink, or pen marks.
